faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nizamabad District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Nizamabad District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, 2 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Dietician, 1 Psychosocial Counselor, 1 Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Nizamabad District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (official website of Nizamabad District) and send it to Romm No 201, District Medical and Health Office, O/o Collector and District Magistrate, Dubba, Nizamabad District, 503001, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: S.C, S.T, BC 5 years, Ex-Service man 3 years in addition to length of service, Disable persons 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.60,000 for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, Rs.40,000 for AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs.20,000 for Dietician, @ Rs.500 per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call) for Psychosocial Counselor, Rs.28,000 for Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy, or Naturopathy; Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homoeopathy, or Naturopathy; B.Sc Nutrition; Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW); Degree in Naturopathy or Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Rules of Reservation in respect of Community, Disability, Ex-service Men shall be strictly observed. Rule of Reservation of Local candidates is applicable as per Presidential order.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after due date will be summarily rejected. Applications submitted with unattested certificate documents will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 90 marks allotted based on marks obtained in qualifying examination. 10 marks awarded for age (0.5 mark for one completed year of age up to 10 marks). Preparation of merit list and display on website. Selection list prepared following rule of reservation and Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recruitment is on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. Services thereafter will be as per need and subject to satisfactory performance.
